opening.argument: The presenter does more than discuss Bitcoin: he urges viewers to purchase a mining-pool contract, promising that "you get bitcoin every single day". He also describes a referral structure in which "you are paid referral commissions" as participants recruit further participants. The opportunity is framed through "massive returns", including the potential to turn a few thousand dollars into hundreds of thousands, even with a non-guarantee disclaimer. Additional earning opportunities are presented through ClubCoin staking, where "you're gonna get a hundred and ten percent" after twelve months, and projected appreciation reaching "one hundred two hundred three hundred dollars for one ClubCoin". These are participation-oriented solicitations built around recurring returns and recruitment-dependent benefits, rather than neutral Bitcoin education.
